Page 122

Listen, o ardent disciples, to the tumultuous saga of sôIôs, the enchanting De - Placement! Infinite ocean of honey, he drags and frees all things through the sacred TENSION (Gravity) of ÉoÀ, the luminous cord uniting each Ril - star like a constellation.

  • Thus, through his flows of integral water, Iôs pulls from sleep the Rilsôi ( Immobile Forms / Immo- bility ) with agility, those Ril - cendrées of ÉoÀ resting there, carrying them in a current crushing them with suffering. Their shooting stars then blaze, awakened into Riliôs ( Moving Forms / Movement ), unleashed and inspiring stars racing at full speed.
  • But what of the impartial dense honey's unctuosity? sôI then embraces the Riliôs in a gentle hold, stopping their course and putting them to sleep as Rilsôi, offering them thus a well-deserved rest. In this instant of serenity, he gives them creative dreams from his reviving juice of hallucinated visions, pacifying them unto near total passivity.
